title: LeetCode 75 Study Plan
description: Curated 75 must-do LeetCode problems covering arrays, two pointers, trees, graphs, and dynamic programming. Ideal starting point for placement prep.

title: NeetCode 150 Roadmap
description: Structured roadmap of 150 LeetCode problems organized by pattern. Includes video explanations for each problem. Best for systematic DSA prep.

title: Striver's A2Z DSA Sheet
description: Comprehensive 450+ problem sheet covering every DSA topic from basics to advanced. Includes video solutions. Very popular among Indian placement aspirants.

title: Full Stack Open (University of Helsinki)
description: Free university-grade course covering React, Node.js, MongoDB, GraphQL, TypeScript, and CI/CD. Hands-on projects with peer review.

title: The Odin Project - Full Stack JavaScript
description: Project-based full stack curriculum. Build real projects: calculator, library app, weather app, todo list. Strong community support.

title: CS50x - Introduction to Computer Science (Harvard)
description: Harvard's famous intro CS course. Covers C, Python, SQL, web development. Excellent for building strong fundamentals from scratch.

title: Python for Everybody (University of Michigan)
description: Gentle introduction to Python covering variables, loops, functions, files, and web scraping. Perfect for absolute beginners.

title: Automate the Boring Stuff with Python
description: Free online book teaching Python through practical projects: web scraping, Excel automation, file management. Great for building confidence.

title: Real Python Tutorials
description: High-quality Python tutorials on advanced topics: decorators, generators, context managers, testing, packaging. Good for leveling up.

title: JavaScript.info - The Modern JavaScript Tutorial
description: Comprehensive JavaScript tutorial from basics to advanced. Covers the language core, browser APIs, and network requests. Well-structured with exercises.

title: React Official Tutorial (react.dev)
description: Official React documentation with interactive examples. Covers components, hooks, state management, and effects. The definitive learning guide.

title: FreeCodeCamp - Machine Learning with Python
description: Free interactive course covering TensorFlow, neural networks, NLP, and reinforcement learning with hands-on projects and certification.

title: Andrew Ng's Machine Learning Specialization
description: The gold standard ML course. Covers supervised/unsupervised learning, recommender systems, and reinforcement learning. Free to audit.

title: Fast.ai - Practical Deep Learning
description: Top-down approach to deep learning. Build working models first, then understand theory. Covers vision, NLP, tabular data, and deployment.

title: Kaggle Learn - Intro to ML
description: Quick hands-on introduction to ML with Kaggle notebooks. Covers decision trees, random forests, and model validation. Free with exercises.

title: SQLBolt - Interactive SQL Lessons
description: Interactive SQL tutorial with exercises. Covers SELECT, JOINs, aggregations, subqueries. Perfect for building SQL fundamentals quickly.

title: Mode SQL Tutorial
description: Advanced SQL tutorial covering window functions, CTEs, pivoting, and performance optimization. Includes real-world analytics examples.

title: Git & GitHub Crash Course (freeCodeCamp)
description: Complete Git and GitHub tutorial covering init, commits, branches, merging, pull requests, and collaboration workflows.

title: System Design Primer (GitHub)
description: Comprehensive system design study guide. Covers scalability, load balancing, caching, database sharding, and popular system design questions.

title: Pandas Documentation Tutorial
description: Official Pandas tutorial covering DataFrames, selecting data, groupby, merging, and time series. Essential for data analysis roles.

title: Scikit-learn User Guide
description: Official scikit-learn documentation with examples for classification, regression, clustering, preprocessing, and model evaluation.

title: MDN Web Docs - HTML, CSS, JavaScript
description: The definitive web development reference. Structured learning path from HTML basics to advanced JavaScript. Maintained by Mozilla.

title: freeCodeCamp - Responsive Web Design
description: Free certification covering HTML, CSS, Flexbox, Grid, accessibility, and responsive design. Build 20 projects to earn certification.

title: InterviewBit - Coding Practice
description: Structured coding practice organized by topic and difficulty. Includes timed tests that simulate real interview conditions. Popular in India.

title: GeeksforGeeks - Placement Preparation
description: Comprehensive placement preparation portal with company-specific questions, aptitude tests, interview experiences, and DSA articles.

title: HackerRank - Interview Preparation Kit
description: Curated set of challenges covering arrays, dictionaries, sorting, graphs, DP, and more. Used by many companies for screening rounds.

title: Eloquent JavaScript (free book)
description: Deep dive into JavaScript covering higher-order functions, modules, asynchronous programming, Node.js, and building a game project.

title: roadmap.sh - Developer Roadmaps
description: Visual roadmaps for frontend, backend, DevOps, and more. Helps you see the big picture and plan your learning path systematically.

title: Codeforces - Competitive Programming
description: Competitive programming platform with regular contests. Great for building speed and problem-solving under pressure. Rating system for tracking progress.

title: Data Science Handbook (GitHub)
description: Free online book covering NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, and Scikit-learn with Jupyter notebooks. Excellent for hands-on data science learning.
